description: Every circuit on every processor registered with the X Layer TapeOut factory, read at one block hash by scripts/census.mjs.

meaning.webExhaustive: stateless and small enough to check every input in the web workbench
meaning.ciExhaustive: stateless; every input checked by the CLI and GitHub Action (not the web workbench)
meaning.wideStateless: stateless but too wide to enumerate: identical-netlist proof or sampled counterexample only
meaning.stateful: has LATCH state: proven only when byte-identical
meaning.unreadable: circuitInfo did not return a TAP-02 answer
